project_type: Strapi 5 plugin with React admin UI + Node server controllers
build_system: npm with Strapi SDK plugin build (NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 strapi build)
test_framework: vitest with nock for HTTP mocking
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` to verify TypeScript compiles and admin UI builds. 2. Run `npm run test` to verify all vitest tests pass.
environment_constraints: CMS-only changes; no engine modifications allowed. AdminClient already has listFlowVersions() and rollbackFlow() methods.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing component patterns (SyncPanel, ValidationPanel, AuditViewer). Server controllers follow sync.ts pattern with fetchImpl test seam. Unit tests required for new components.
key_patterns: Admin components use @strapi/design-system (Box, Flex, Typography, Table, Badge, Button, Modal). useFetchClient for API calls. FetchState discriminated union for loading/error/ok states. Server controllers use factory pattern with strapi injection and fetchImpl test seam. Types kept local to admin bundle (not importing from root types/). Tests use nock + httpFetch shim.
directory_structure: cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/components/ - React components, cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/pages/ - Route pages, cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/controllers/ - Server controllers, cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/services/ - Services like AdminClient, cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/routes/ - Route definitions, cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/tests/ - Server-side tests
